import_folder.doc: Import entire folder recursively from another Drumee instance

source_url.description: Base URL of the source Drumee instance to import from (e.g. https://source.drumee.com)

hub_id.description: Hub ID on the source Drumee instance containing the folder to import

nid.description: Node ID of the folder on the source Drumee instance to import recursively

token.description: MFS API token for authenticating requests to the source Drumee instance. Sent as x-param-mfs-token header.

dest_nid.description: Destination folder node ID in the local Drumee MFS where the imported content will be placed. Defaults to the current user home folder if not provided.

returns.description: Result object. On success contains status ok and import statistics. On failure contains status error with error code and message.

status.description: Result status: ok on success, error on failure

stats.description: Import statistics object, present on success. Contains folders, files, skipped counts and a per-file errors array.

error.description: Error code on failure: missing_parameters, invalid_dest, or internal_error

errors.message: source_url, hub_id, nid, and token are required
Failed to import: error message from exception

import_file.doc: Import single file from another Drumee instance

source_url.description: Base URL of the source Drumee instance to import from (e.g. https://source.drumee.com)

hub_id.description: Hub ID on the source Drumee instance containing the file to import

nid.description: Node ID of the file on the source Drumee instance to import

token.description: MFS API token for authenticating requests to the source Drumee instance. Sent as x-param-mfs-token header.

dest_nid.description: Destination folder node ID in the local Drumee MFS where the imported file will be placed. Defaults to the current user home folder if not provided.

filename.description: Override filename for the imported file. If provided, the file is stored with this name instead of the original filename from the source.

returns.description: Result object. On success contains status ok and the newly created MFS node. On failure contains status error with error code and message.

status.description: Result status: ok on success, error on failure

node.description: The newly created MFS node object in local Drumee, present on success. Contains id, file_path, filename, mimetype, filesize, and other standard MFS node attributes.

error.description: Error code on failure: missing_parameters, invalid_dest, node_not_found, or internal_error

errors.message: source_url, hub_id, nid, and token are required
Failed to import file: error message from exception
